summary: Global Mofy AI Limited, a Cayman-incorporated foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a self-underwritten registered direct offering under its effective Form F-3 shelf (File No. 333-294113, declared effective March 18, 2026). On October 30, 2026 it signed a securities purchase agreement with certain investors for 45,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at $0.22 per share, approximately $9.9 million gross before expenses. No placement agent discounts or commissions were paid. Closing is expected on or about November 6, 2026, subject to customary conditions; Ogier provided the legality opinion. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and post-deal overhang.
